title: The comparison map between pullback and the right adjoint is compatible with base change of the comparison diagram
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: For the diagram of equation labelled equation-base-change with f and g Tor independent and K in D_QCoh(O_Y), the lemma asserts that the square relating L(g')^*(Lf^*K otimes a(O_Y)) -> L(g')^*a(K) to L(f')^*Lg^*K otimes a'(O_{Y'}) -> a'(Lg^*K) commutes, where the horizontal arrows are the comparison maps of equation labelled equation-compare-with-pullback for K and for Lg^*K and the vertical maps are built from the base change remark and from equation labelled equation-base-change-map (statement lines 2118-2135). The proof rewrites the comparison map as a four step composition: the unit eta_f, the pushforward of the projection formula map of Cohomology, Equation labelled cohomology-equation-projection-formula-map (an isomorphism by Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-cohomology-base-change), the pushforward of id_K otimes Tr_f, and the pushforward of the isomorphism K otimes O_Y = K (proof lines 2137-2154). It then checks that each of the four maps produces a commutative square: for eta_f and Tr_f this is Lemmas labelled lemma-unit-and-base-change and lemma-trace-map-and-base-change, for the projection formula arrow it is Cohomology, Remark labelled cohomology-remark-compatible-with-diagram, and for the multiplication map it is clear (proof lines 2156-2168). Decomposing the comparison map into four maps whose base change compatibility is either known or formal is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
